li: Term fees due in the first week of term
Two weeks notice to withdraw, pro-rated refund
Missed classes may be made up in any equivalent level
Hair secured for every class, no exceptions
Mobile phones stay in lockers during class time
p: Policies exist so the studio runs quietly and everyone knows where they stand. They are short by design.
If circumstances make a policy unworkable for your family, speak to the office. Nobody has ever lost a place here over money.
Everything below applies equally to children, adults, and pre-professional students.
Regular attendance matters more than natural facility. The body learns by repetition on a schedule.
Notify the office for absences of more than two consecutive weeks so the place is held.
Dancers arriving more than ten minutes late may be asked to observe rather than join an unwarmed body to a moving class.
Report injuries before class, not after. Modified participation is almost always possible.
Faculty are trained in first aid and in recognising the early signs of overuse injury and disordered eating.
The studio does not weigh students, comment on body size, or permit others to do so on the premises.
Graded levels wear the leotard colour of their grade with pink tights and appropriate shoes.
Hair in a secure bun for all ballet classes. Loose hair is a safety matter in turning and partnering.
Adult open classes have no dress code beyond clothing that lets the teacher see alignment.
No filming or photography in class without written consent from every family present.
Studio images used in publicity require separate opt-in consent, renewed annually.
Student records are held only as long as enrollment continues plus one year.
